title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Rimac Nevera
description:
Behind the seats of the Rimac Nevera, there is a fire extinguisher with a strap that says, in case of hill climb, extinguish fire. It is a joke, and it points to one of the most famous crashes in television history. And that is only the first of two things you probably did not know about the world's most powerful electric hypercar. Here is the second hint. A car built to set acceleration records also carries a full set of self-driving sensors, and an artificial intelligence coach that can teach you how to drive on a track, without a human instructor beside you. A fire joke and a robot coach, inside the same car.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
